sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Final Stretch is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good thing you didn't disappear. Even with your help, they somehow spotted my people. Every last one of them got killed on the way back while crossing part of their route through the center of downtown. But before that happened, my team reported finding a rugged laptop protected by some serious security. During the attack, my boys were supposed to stash it in one of the hidden caches there in the center. I've got no reason to doubt them, so the hardware should still be there. Check those stashes, find the laptop, and bring it to me. Whatever's stored on a sealed TerraGroup site like that will be worth a great deal, even if not directly."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the laptop from Fence's stash on Streets of Tarkov
- Hand over the found item

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +35,000 EXP
- 300,000 Roubles
  - 315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× RB-BK marked key
- 1× Briefcase with documents
- Unlocks achievement Profit Over Principles
"You didn't see my people's bodies near the stashes? Then they managed to draw those operators away before they went down. That's good. I'm not some cheap hustler. When I make a deal, I honor it. Your reward's already waiting. Go collect it."

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "Good thing I don't put my trust in outsiders. You had a rare chance to work with me, and you blew it over some naive bullshit Mechanic fed you. Should've seen that coming. Get lost, merc."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| Laptop from an unknown facility | 1 | Required | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to find and hand over a Laptop from an unknown facility to Fence. The laptop is located at a small ventilation chimney in an alley behind the diner on Nikitskaya Street on Streets of Tarkov.
